Sample first and last 3 rows of mmc1 sheet UCEC_CPTAC3_meta_table_V2.1 to inspect columns for histology/subtype and variants per Mbp
Load full mmc1.xlsx sheet UCEC_CPTAC3_meta_table_V2.1 containing sample metadata including Histologic_type and Log2_variant_per_Mbp

operatorProperties.code:
def process(meta) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd
    df = meta.copy()

    # Keep tumor samples (if column exists)
    if 'Proteomics_Tumor_Normal' in df.columns:
        df = df[df['Proteomics_Tumor_Normal'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower().eq('tumor')]

    # Exclude cases marked excluded
    if 'Case_excluded' in df.columns:
        df = df[~df['Case_excluded'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower().eq('yes')]

    # Serous histologic type
    hist = df['Histologic_type'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
    df = df[hist.eq('serous')]

    # Convert log2 variants/Mbp to variants/Mbp
    x = pd.to_numeric(df['Log2_variant_per_Mbp'], errors='coerce')
    df = df.assign(variants_per_Mbp=(2 ** x))

    # Keep essential columns
    keep_cols = [c for c in ['idx','Proteomics_Participant_ID','Histologic_type','Log2_variant_per_Mbp','variants_per_Mbp'] if c in df.columns]
    return df[keep_cols]
